Casting a Non-{c_important}Basic{/c} {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

Casting a {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skill with {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} increases its damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100 |%x|]{/c}.
